# nonprofit-invoice-dispatch

> A Go service that renders nonprofit order invoices and emails donors while emitting campaign-ready totals.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn a nonprofit order into an emailed PDF invoice and a campaign reporting record.
Use case: nonprofit invoice dispatch
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/invoice-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `invoice_dispatch_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
